final: SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_pressratio, AVG(g.avg_sizepermin) AS avg_of_avg_gb_per_min FROM (SELECT s.zoneref, si.typesite, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) AS avg_sizepermin FROM scans s JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE CAST(s.chronotag AS TEXT) >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND CAST(s.chronotag AS TEXT) <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.typesite) g
